nl: 边界管理：查询边界名称；表格展示边界名称、类型；边界是树形结构，子边界放在 items 字段里，默认全部展开；支持新增、编辑、删除。
nlEn: Boundary management: query by boundary name; the table shows boundary name and type; boundaries are hierarchical with children under the items field and all nodes start expanded; supports add, edit and delete.
notes: AI-09 子项③: 自定义 childrenField=items + expandAll（vue3/SFC）
